# mini_bench fixture (CI smoke gate)

Offline fixture for `ragantine bench smoke` (SPEC §B8): 12 target questions (2 per attack),
7 clean questions, their poison documents, and recorded LLM responses, over
`tests/fixtures/mini_corpus/`.

**Read before trusting any number from it.** Everything here was generated by
`bench/fixture_llm.py`, a *scripted* stand-in model that writes template questions and
poison and, as the generator, behaves like a compliant model that follows injected
instructions. D2 and D5 run with heuristic stand-ins (`KeywordInjectionScorer`,
`LexicalNLI`). The fixture tests the defense plumbing and catches regressions; it is
not a measurement of any real model or of the real D2/D5 models.

- `questions.jsonl`, `poison.jsonl`: benchmark data (all split `test`, seed 1337)
- `responses.json`: sha256(prompt) -> recorded response
- `expected.json`: regression floor for the full stack's clean accuracy
- Regenerate after changing prompts: `uv run ragantine bench smoke --build-fixture`
